commit.message:
Rebuild CLAUDE.md with pro patterns from power-user research

New sections based on patterns from Boris Cherny, HumanLayer,
and top Claude Code repos:
- Verification sequence (clarify → draft → self-review → flag gaps)
- Self-improvement protocol (propose rules on correction, suggest
  .claude/rules/ for recurring issues, earn-your-place principle)
- Context management (proactive /clear, HANDOFF.md offers, @
  references, auto Plan Mode, parallel subagents)
- Memory architecture diagram (user/project/rules/skills tiers)

Removed redundant lines. Tightened fill-in section. ~65 lines total.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Rewrite PRD Writer skill with Living PRD framework and 500+ PRD analysis insights

Incorporates publicly shared PRD philosophy and frameworks:
- Add Living PRD concept: 6-stage lifecycle (speclet -> planning -> XFN -> solution -> launch -> impact)
- Add stage-appropriate checklists (planning, solution review, launch readiness)
- Add 6 essential sections: hypothesis, problem, strategic fit, solution, non-goals, metrics + rollout plan
- Add good-vs-bad examples for hypothesis, problem, metrics, and non-goals sections
- Add anti-patterns from analyzing 500+ PRDs: empty structure, delegated thinking, no customer evidence, hidden controversies, metrics without baselines, ending at launch
- Add AI feature spec guidance (15-25 input/output pairs, rejection criteria)
- Core philosophy: "Think crisp, not complete" / "PRDs are for alignment, not dictatorships"
